## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.5.0`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/style/noExcessiveLinesPerFile`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule isn't recommended, so you need to enable it.
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"noExcessiveLinesPerFile": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Restrict the number of lines in a file.

Large HTML and component files are harder to navigate and maintain. A line limit can
encourage splitting unrelated markup into focused components or templates.

## Examples

### Invalid

This example reports a diagnostic when `maxLines` is `2`:

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"noExcessiveLinesPerFile": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxLines": 2
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```html
<div></div>
<span></span>
<p></p>
```

## Options

### `maxLines`

Sets the maximum number of lines allowed in a file. Defaults to `300`.

This example lowers the limit to `4` and reports a five-line file:

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"noExcessiveLinesPerFile": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxLines": 4
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```html
<div>Line 1</div>
<div>Line 2</div>
<div>Line 3</div>
<div>Line 4</div>
<div>Line 5</div>
```

### `skipBlankLines`

Excludes blank lines from the line count when set to `true`. Defaults to `false`.

Here, the blank lines do not count toward the limit:

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"noExcessiveLinesPerFile": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxLines": 2,
						"skipBlankLines": true
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```html
<div></div>


<span></span>
```

## Suppressions

If you need to exceed the line limit in a specific file, you can suppress this rule
at the top of the file:

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"noExcessiveLinesPerFile": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"maxLines": 2
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```html
<!-- biome-ignore-all lint/style/noExcessiveLinesPerFile: generated file -->
<div></div>
<span></span>
<p></p>
```
